t: Paul V Azzopardi concludes term as MDB CEO
html:
The Malta Development Bank has announced that Paul V. Azzopardi has concluded his term as Chief Executive Officer. In a statement, the Bank’s Board of Directors expressed their appreciation for Mr. Azzopardi’s leadership over the past three years, as well as for his earlier role as Deputy CEO.

The Board praised his dedication and key contributions to the Bank’s progress and strategic development, acknowledging his role in shaping its growth trajectory.

As Mr. Azzopardi moves on to new endeavours, the Board extended its best wishes for his future. In the meantime, Deputy CEO Alison Micallef has assumed the duties and responsibilities of CEO to ensure continuity in leadership until further notice.
